a1
Dinah, Jacob's daughter, went out to visit the women of the land.
a2
Shechem, the ruler's son, seized her and assaulted her. Then he wanted to marry her.
b1
Jacob heard, and kept silent until his sons came in from the field. They were grieved and very angry.
b2
Hamor, Shechem's father, came to ask for Dinah as his son's wife.
c1
Jacob's sons answered deceitfully: we cannot give our sister to an uncircumcised man. Every man in your city must be circumcised.
c2
The men agreed, and were circumcised.
d1
On the third day, while the men were in pain, Simeon and Levi took swords, entered the city, and killed every male. They took Dinah out of Shechem's house.
e1
The other sons plundered the city, and took its women and children captive. Jacob said: you have brought trouble on me. They said: should he treat our sister like that?
h1
Dinah was wronged, and her brothers' anger was real.
h2
But they answered with deceit and killing, and a whole city paid.
h3
Anger at injustice is understandable. Violence that falls on the innocent cannot heal a wound.
h4
Today, stand with someone who has been hurt, and listen.
i
Who needs you to stand with them today?
